image.location.auditorium-early.label: Conference auditorium
image.location.auditorium-early.desc: A huge darkened auditorium seen from high up at the back and off to the left, looking down over row after row of audience toward a brightly lit stage at the right. Nearly everything is in deep shadow, plum and near-black, so the stage glows like a window in the dark. Across the top of the stage runs a black lighting truss hung with spotlights. They glint pale blue, white and rose-pink, and one blue lamp at the left flares into a sharp starburst. A tall lattice tower of scaffolding rises at the left edge of the stage, hung with more lamps. Behind the stage hangs an enormous projection screen in soft teal-grey. Thin glowing cyan letters spell "OneMind 2.0" across it, with "Escalating the Wellness Revolution" underneath. A scatter of angular triangles in magenta, orange, blue and green looks like a burst of confetti or a stylised flower. A lone speaker, small at this distance, stands at the centre of the stage in a pool of cyan light, hands together, between a few low floor monitors. Below, the audience is a sea of heads and shoulders in dim silhouette, packed tight row on row. A few people stand along the left aisle, and in the right foreground a dark figure stands at the edge of the frame. The mood is hushed and expectant, a tech-keynote spectacle, polished and corporate and a little overwhelming. On the projection screen the presentation keeps changing. Teal diagrams with arrows and labels such as "NLU", "Analysis" and "Real-time" give way to bright white-and-blue logo slides, then pale slides of statistics about community and development, then warm red-and-orange slides with round, face-like graphics. The tiny speaker also shifts position from time to time.
image.location.cafe-a.label: Komorebi café
image.location.cafe-a.desc: A straight-on view of a small café's storefront from across the sidewalk, flat and symmetrical like a stage set. It sits on the ground floor of an old red-brick building, and the bottoms of three upper-floor windows with stone sills show at the top of the frame. The whole shopfront is painted a rich forest green. Above it, a dark charcoal signboard carries wide, evenly spaced cream capital letters reading "KOMOREBI". At the left is a green door with the street number "342" above it. A tall vertical sign in Japanese kana hangs in its glass, and lower down the glass reads "KOMOREBI, open daily, 7am - 7pm". To the right, a large multi-paned window looks into the warm, softly lit interior. There is a chalkboard menu listing espresso, americano, cappuccino, latte, mocha, chai, hot cocoa, hot tea and iced tea, each with a price. Shelves behind the counter hold jars, bags of beans and bottles, and a pastry case sits on the counter. A man with his back to the street stands at the counter, a bearded barista works behind an espresso machine, and a woman with long hair in a white coat waits at the right. Small signs in the window include a food menu card, a small rainbow sticker and a box labelled "mors roasters". In the foreground are a pale concrete sidewalk, a steel bike rack at the left and a bare metal signpost at the right. The light is late afternoon: a long diagonal shadow covers the right side of the scene and the neighbouring buildings, while the left half is lit warmly. The mood is quiet, cosy and everyday, a neighbourhood refuge. The people inside the café appear to move subtly, shifting and gesturing as they go about ordering and making coffee.
image.location.campfire.label: Lakeside campsite at night
image.location.campfire.desc: A wide night scene from inside a dark forest, looking out between tall tree trunks at a still lake under a starry sky. Huge conifer trunks frame the view. Two stand at the left, their bark lit a coppery red on the side facing the fire, and another thick dark trunk rises at the right. Bare, crooked branches reach across the top of the picture. The sky is deep navy and full of stars, and a hazy band of the Milky Way sweeps up through it from the centre, faintly green. Toward the horizon a soft green glow lingers. Across the lake, low wooded hills and small islands of spiky fir trees stand in black silhouette, and the calm water reflects the sky in dark blue. In the middle ground, on a bare patch of earth by the shore, three people sit around a small, bright campfire with their backs mostly to the viewer. They sit on a log and on the ground, and the orange firelight catches their shoulders and hair. A thin column of pale smoke drifts up from the flames across the water behind them. A large boulder sits to the left of the group. At the right, an orange dome tent glows faintly among young fir saplings. The foreground is dark scrub, ferns and fallen branches. The mood is intimate, peaceful and remote, a quiet night far from the city. The campfire flickers continually. Its flames dance and change shape, the warm light it casts on the nearby trunks, ground and figures pulses, and the smoke above it shifts and drifts.
image.location.conference-room.label: Conference room
image.location.conference-room.desc: A plain, front-on view of one wall of a modern conference room, cool, quiet and minimalist. The wall is built from large panels of smooth grey concrete or plaster. Thin seams run between them in an irregular grid, dotted with small round bolt holes like formwork ties. A few warm, blurred spots of light glow near the top of the wall, reflections of ceiling lamps. A very large flat-screen display is set into a recessed rectangular niche in the middle of the wall. It is switched off, its glass a glossy black with a faint grey sheen, and a small black remote lies on the lip of the niche below it. Beneath it stands a long, low white credenza with a dark wood top and a slim steel frame. It has banks of drawers at each end and three plain cupboard doors in the middle. Its top is neatly arranged: a small stack of yellow notepads and a cup of pencils at the left, a wooden rack of five upright black tablets, a slim keyboard, and a small round videoconference camera in the centre. At the right are stacked drinking glasses and a tall metal water pitcher. A power cord trails from the credenza to a wall outlet at the lower left. A dark-framed glass door or partition edges the left side of the view. At the right, a tall window lets in flat, pale, overcast daylight that falls across a deep stone sill. The palette is all greys, whites and cold blue-greys, and the mood is sterile, corporate and expectant, a room waiting for a meeting.
image.location.convention-center.label: Convention center lobby
image.location.convention-center.desc: The vast upper-level lobby of a modern convention centre, seen from a mezzanine walkway that curves away into the scene. The ceiling is high and dark, a faceted pattern of triangular panels with small recessed lights and thin diagonal beams. At the left, a wall of tall glass windows looks out on neighbouring office towers in grey daylight. A thick square pillar clad in dark triangular tiles rises in the left foreground. A wall-mounted screen on it shows a live feed of the keynote: a small figure on a stage in front of a teal "OneMind 2.0" backdrop. The right half of the picture is filled by a massive curved wall, the outside of the auditorium. It is grey and tan with long horizontal dark bands like stretched louvres. Across its lower part hangs a wide teal banner with "OneMind 2.0" in thin glowing cyan letters and "Escalating the Wellness Revolution" beneath. Bright angular triangles in green, magenta, blue and orange are scattered across it. Beneath the banner, a set of tall double doors leads into the hall. A glass balustrade with a warm wooden handrail sweeps around the opening of the atrium. Through and below it, a handful of small figures in business clothes stand and chat on the lower floor near the doors. The polished floor reflects the light softly. The mood is large, impersonal and corporate, a big tech event in its in-between moments.
image.location.counseling-office.label: Eliza counseling center lobby
image.location.counseling-office.desc: The reception area of a calm, modern counselling clinic, seen from a slight angle with the front desk on the left and a waiting area on the right. The left side is dominated by a feature wall in deep emerald green, faceted with subtle triangular planes. In large soft white lowercase letters it reads "eliza", with "Powered by Skandha" in smaller type beneath beside a small stacked-block logo. Five glass pendant lamps with glowing bare bulbs hang from the ceiling in front of it, giving off a warm amber light. In front of the wall curves a long reception desk with a brushed-steel front and a dark wood top. On it are a computer monitor, a cup of pens, a phone on a stand, a small trailing green plant and an empty black mesh office chair. Behind the desk, the room opens onto a beige hallway with a plain wooden door marked "1". Along the back wall stand a white water cooler, a steel pedal bin and a dark wood sideboard with a coffee machine, stacked paper cups and supplies. Above the sideboard hangs wall art made of white wireframe cubes clustered together. At the right, a large multi-paned window shows a pale blue-grey sky, with a tall snake plant in a white pot beside it. In the foreground, four mustard-yellow upholstered armchairs with wooden arms sit in a row on a round grey rug, next to a small side table with a potted plant, some magazines and a box of tissues. The floor is warm wood. Recessed ceiling lights glow softly. The mood is soothing, tidy and deliberately welcoming, with a faint corporate polish.
image.location.dream-city.label: Lakeside terrace in a dreamlike city
image.location.dream-city.desc: A bright, idealised view from a pale stone terrace looking out over a sparkling blue lake on a summer day. It is painted in a soft, saturated style that feels almost too perfect. In the foreground, wide cream-coloured paving slabs lead toward a short flight of steps that descends to the water. At the left stands the corner of a sleek modern glass building with a deep flat overhanging roof. A glass balustrade and a black metal handrail run down beside the stairs. Just right of centre, a raised concrete planter holds a small garden of grass, rocks, ornamental grasses and a cluster of slender, white-trunked young trees with bright green leaves. At the right, a large tree with peeling reddish bark spreads its leafy branches over the scene. Behind it, white and pale pink terraced buildings step down toward the shore, each level with black railings, potted topiary trees and lush plantings. Dark leaves hang into the top right corner. Beyond, the lake stretches to a far shore of dark green forest, with a few small houses at the left and a long blue mountain ridge softened by haze. The sky is deep, rich blue, and huge billowing cumulus clouds are lit warm cream and peach on one side. The mood is serene, hopeful and utopian, a clean, green, peaceful city of the future, or a dream of one. The surface of the lake glitters and ripples, with sunlight sparkling across the small waves.
image.location.evelyns-apt.label: Evelyn's apartment
image.location.evelyns-apt.desc: A large, dim bedroom and living space at night, seen from near the foot of the bed looking toward a wall of tall windows. The room is lit only by a single tall floor lamp with a warm cream shade at the left and the cold blue glow of night from outside. Most surfaces sit in deep shadow, browns and charcoal greys tinged with blue. In the left foreground is the corner of an unmade bed with a rumpled dark green-grey blanket, a pillow, a loose white shirt or sock, and a small book with a square pattern on its cover. Against the left wall stands a dark wooden chest of drawers, with a teal laundry basket of folded clothes on top and a framed line drawing hanging above. Next to it are two tall dark bookcases, full but slightly disorganised, with an open cardboard box and a few other boxes stacked on top. A black umbrella leans in the corner. The back wall is almost entirely window, covered by vertical blinds that are partly open to a dark blue night view of indistinct shapes. A few pairs of shoes are scattered on the floor beneath. To the right, framed artworks lean against the wall, unhung, one of them a grid of coloured squares. Beside them is another wooden bookcase with books, a parcel box and small storage drawers. In the right foreground is a desk with a black office chair, a keyboard, a mouse, a computer monitor seen edge-on, a printer, a pink sticky note and a scatter of papers and mail. Notes are pinned on the wall above. The wooden floor faintly reflects the blue window light. The mood is quiet, solitary and a little unsettled, a home still half moved into.
image.location.light-rail-a.label: Light rail car
image.location.light-rail-a.desc: The inside of an empty light-rail train car, seen from standing height in the aisle looking straight down its length toward the next connected car. The aisle floor is a smooth blue-green with a ribbed grey strip running down the middle. On both sides are paired seats with brushed-steel shells and deep blue patterned upholstery flecked with lighter blue and mauve. Some face forward and some backward, and padded grey panels and grab rails stand between them. Vertical steel poles rise from floor to ceiling throughout. Overhead, horizontal bars carry hanging black rubber hand straps, and a cluster of loose looped straps dangles at the upper left. The walls and ceiling are a warm cream-beige, lit by a long strip of fluorescent light down the ceiling, and a small dark dome camera is mounted overhead. Large rounded windows line both sides, their glass dark, showing nothing outside. At the right are teal-green doors, small red emergency signs and an intercom button. On a seat back at the left, blue signs show a wheelchair accessibility symbol with small print and a luggage symbol with a downward arrow. Toward the back, a beige bulkhead shows the car number "114A" and a red fire extinguisher behind glass. Through the open gangway the next car recedes in perspective, with more blue seats and a blue door at the far end. The mood is quiet, fluorescent and slightly lonely, a late or off-peak commute. As the train moves, the hanging straps sway and swing, and bands of light and shadow slide across the seats, poles and walls, as if from passing lights outside. Small orange glints also flicker, possibly from a lit display or signal lights passing by.
image.location.night-city.label: City skyline at night
image.location.night-city.desc: A wide, moody nighttime view across dark water to a city skyline. A lone figure stands at a railing in the foreground, seen from behind. The sky is a heavy, overcast slate grey-violet with no stars. Across the water, a dense downtown of high-rise towers spreads across the middle of the picture. Their windows are dotted with warm yellow and white lights, and a few rooftops glow teal or mint green. Red aviation warning lights sit on top of many of the taller buildings. Along the waterfront below are lower buildings, a long low pavilion with a peaked roof lit warm white, a tree strung with small lights, and scattered amber streetlamps. The water in the middle ground is dark and still, holding long vertical streaks of reflected light in gold, teal, blue and orange that break into horizontal ripples. In the foreground, a long black metal railing of evenly spaced vertical bars runs straight across the full width of the picture. Behind it is a paved promenade of dark tiles, wet and faintly reflective. To the right of centre stands a solitary person in silhouette, wearing a knee-length coat, with chin-length hair. They lean slightly toward the railing, gazing out at the city. The mood is contemplative, melancholy and still, the city vast and glittering while the watcher is small and alone. The reflections on the water ripple and shimmer continuously, the colours wavering and breaking up, and lights in the skyline and along the shore twinkle and flicker. The wet promenade's reflections shimmer faintly as well.
image.location.nightclub.label: Nightclub
image.location.nightclub.desc: A dark, crowded live-music club seen from the back of the room, looking over a sea of heads toward a low stage. Almost everything is drenched in deep oxblood red and near-black, so shapes come out of the gloom only where light catches them. In the foreground stand several round, tall bar tables, empty, each holding a small glass candle holder that glows orange-red like an ember; one sits front and centre, two more on the left and one on the right. Behind them, waist-high metal railings mark off a standing area packed with the audience, drawn as a dense mass of silhouetted heads and shoulders, their hair rimmed with faint red light from the stage. A thick square pillar rises up the left third of the frame, completely plastered in layered black-and-white band stickers and flyers; one reads "FAKER". Far left is a dim violet-tinted bar: shelves of bottles framed by a string of small warm bulbs, a menu board, and a grey back-room door with a small lit window. The stage at the back has a wood-panelled red wall, a table draped in black cloth covered with electronic gear and a laptop, stacked amplifier cabinets and speaker boxes, and two big black speakers hanging from the ceiling. Above the stage runs a row of small spotlights alternating red and blue. On the right wall hang gig posters, partly cut off: one with the words "HOT", "CIRC", "FORTHER", "VENDE" and "GRACELA", a yellow one reading "THE DIV", "WITH STAR", "AND BIKIN", "SPECIAL", and a blue one with the word "WIRE". The mood is close, smoky and loud even in stillness, a small underground venue just before or during a set. The room is heavily animated. The red and blue stage spotlights sweep and pulse, throwing cones of hot pink and electric blue light down across the stage and over the crowd in shifting patterns, so the colour of the room keeps changing between red, magenta and blue. The crowd bobs and sways, heads shifting and turning. The candles on the tables flicker. On stage a performer appears at the gear table: a slim figure with short, pale blond hair and headphones around the neck, bent over the equipment, moving their hands across it like a DJ.
image.location.noras-apt.label: Nora's apartment
image.location.noras-apt.desc: A cosy loft apartment at night that doubles as a home music studio, seen from just inside the room. The walls are a mix of exposed red-brown brick and pale plaster under a ceiling of white-painted beams and dark exposed pipes. The centrepiece is a wooden work table in the middle of the floor covered with synthesizers. A vintage-looking analog synth with a wooden case and a full keyboard sits on the left. Behind it stands a tall modular synth rack, a wall of knobs and jacks tangled with colourful patch cables in red, yellow and green. A bright red compact keyboard sits in front, with a pair of headphones, a small mixer, a drum machine, and an open laptop whose screen shows coloured bars of a music arrangement. A round wooden stool waits in front of the table. Two industrial pendant lamps hang over it, one lit, throwing a cone of warm light. Behind the table, three tall white-framed sash windows in the brick wall look out on dark Seattle streets: street lamps, glowing apartment windows and dark trees. A small cactus sits on one sill, a leafy potted plant stands beside the windows, and a radiator sits under the right one. A white T-shirt hangs on a hanger from a ceiling pipe. On the right, a glass-based table lamp glows warm amber on a low shelf packed with records, beneath a framed black-and-white portrait poster. A sliding barn-style door on the far right is covered in stickers, one reading "BEA", another partly "PPERDSTARK". On the left, a wooden workbench holds a red bag, wine bottles, an old radio and small electronics. Beside it are drawer cabinets, a speaker on a high shelf of books, and an open doorway to a dim hallway. A small black cat sits on a cardboard box under the bench. The palette is muted green-grey and brick brown with pools of warm lamplight, quiet and creative. The animation is very small: a scattering of tiny points, probably indicator lights on the synthesizers and studio gear, and possibly the laptop display, softly blinking.
image.location.raes-house.label: Rae's house
image.location.raes-house.desc: A warm, lived-in living room in an older craftsman-style house at night, seen from a corner looking across the room. The walls are soft grey-green above white wainscot panelling, with crisp white trim and crown moulding. The back wall is a deep bay alcove with a built-in window seat. Its cushion is heaped with patterned throw pillows in rust, cream, striped and geometric fabrics, and there are bookshelves built in beneath it. The windows above have diamond-leaded upper panes and look out onto dark night-time branches. The alcove is overflowing with plants: macramé hangers holding trailing greenery and a deep-red hanging plant, potted cacti and succulents along the sill, a tall leafy tree in a pot at its left end, and small wall-mounted lanterns glowing at the sides. A smaller leaded window to the right has its own cacti and a stained-glass table lamp casting amber light on a side table. On the left wall hang a poster of a red rhinoceros reading "UNESCO RHINOCEROS" and a long dark textile in red and gold with intricate symmetric patterns. Below them a narrow console table holds a round clay pot, a candle and a copper watering can. Near the right window are two small framed prints, one a teal-and-orange poster with the words "STRANGE INTERLUDE". A large tan cloth printed with rows of dark triangles hangs on the right wall above a wooden-framed sofa covered in striped and patterned cushions. The glossy dark wood floor is layered with rugs: a pale blue-and-cream patterned rug at bottom left, a striped runner by the window seat, and a rich red rug under a low black coffee table. Floor cushions in cream, tan and grey are scattered around it. The mood is homely, eclectic and quietly welcoming, lit by soft lamplight against the night.
image.location.rainers-office.label: Rainer's office
image.location.rainers-office.desc: A vast, minimalist executive office high in a downtown tower, seen from the middle of the room facing a wall of floor-to-ceiling windows. The light is cool, grey-blue daylight under an overcast sky, and the whole palette is slate, steel and dark polished wood. Through the huge black-framed glass panes rise neighbouring glass-and-concrete skyscrapers. Between them, in the far distance, is a narrow glimpse of hazy water and a low line of hills. In the centre of the room stands a long, dark wooden desk on two solid cabinet pedestals, almost bare: a slim desk lamp, an open laptop, a few papers and a mug, and a couple of books on the right. A single tan leather office chair on a chrome base is pushed slightly away behind it. The floor is made of large, dark, glossy tiles with darker inset bands, reflecting the windows like still water. The entire left wall is a towering built-in bookcase of dark wood with a rolling library ladder leaning against it. Its shelves hold rows of leather-bound books, carved statuettes, a golden figurine of a horse or dragon, a white ceramic vessel, lidded ginger jars and a small stone relief. Fitted cabinets run along its base. A tall white hanging scroll in the middle of the shelves bears one large black brushstroke calligraphy character, 道, with red seal stamps. Near the right-hand window stand a small tree with red leaves in a ceramic pot and a tall dark-red vase on the sill. The mood is austere, wealthy and controlled: enormous empty space, very few objects, and the cold city pressing in through the glass.
image.location.restaurant-soren.label: Restaurant
image.location.restaurant-soren.desc: An upscale, dimly lit restaurant dining room in the evening, seen from table height among the diners. The back wall is a run of tall dark-wood panels, each with a warm amber spotlight from above. The spotlights wash down in glowing vertical streaks that make the wood look like burnished copper, while the gaps between them fall into near-black. Small recessed ceiling lights dot the darkness above. Below the panels runs a long deep-green banquette. Tables with crisp white cloths fill the room, each lit by a small glass votive candle, and wine glasses of red and white catch the light. The room is full of other diners, painted as part of the scene. On the left a dark-haired woman sits beside a man seen from behind, across from a bald man in a pale shirt, around a platter of oysters and glasses of champagne. A woman with long wavy blonde hair in a dark red dress sits in profile reaching across her table. In the centre, against the banquette, a dark-haired young woman looks straight out toward the viewer over the shoulder of a grey-haired man facing away from us. On the right a smiling man in a dark polo sits opposite another diner, and an older grey-haired man with a moustache reads a menu. In the right foreground, close to us, a man in a dark suit with short black hair cuts into his meal with a knife and fork beside a glass of red wine. Empty tables in the foreground frame the bottom of the view. The mood is hushed, intimate and expensive: low conversation, candlelight and polished wood. The diners are gently animated, with small lifelike movements. Heads turn and tilt, hands lift glasses and gesture, cutlery moves over plates, and people shift in their seats, so the room feels quietly alive with conversation.
image.location.server-room.label: Server room
image.location.server-room.desc: A large, clean data centre seen through a floor-to-ceiling glass wall divided into tall panes by thick black mullions. The viewer stands in a dim corridor outside, whose polished dark floor reflects the bright room beyond. Inside, under a warm grey ceiling grid lit by rows of cool white fluorescent panels, stand long rows of server cabinets. Their ends are capped with tall dark-green enclosures, each printed with the word "SKANDHA" and a small logo of stacked blocks. The doors of the cabinets show racks of grey and black server units in neat horizontal layers, dotted with tiny status lights. A central aisle runs straight away from the viewer down the middle of the image, floored with perforated grey ventilation tiles. It leads in strong one-point perspective to a far wall with a pair of grey doors under a small green exit sign. Massive grey ducting and cable trays hang overhead, with green crossbeams and bundles of yellow cabling looped between them. On the left, a small monitor and keyboard on a pull-out shelf glow from one rack. On the upper right, the glass itself carries a large white corporate decal: "SKANDHA" in thin capital letters beside a 3D logo of stacked cubes, with the tagline "HUMANITY'S POTENTIAL. OUR TECHNOLOGY." beneath. The palette is cool teal-green, steel grey and clinical white, and the mood is sterile, orderly, humming and impersonal, a room built for machines. The animation is subtle: tiny status lights on the server racks blink on and off in shifting patterns.
image.location.sorens-apt.label: Soren's apartment
image.location.sorens-apt.desc: A sleek, high-ceilinged modern apartment at night, seen across a polished concrete floor toward a full wall of black-framed glass. The space is cool and spare, with mid-century modern furniture. The dominant feature is a striking chandelier hanging from the double-height ceiling: a cluster of glowing white glass globes on brass rods, cascading in tiers. Its soft golden light reflects in long smears across the glossy grey floor. Beyond the glass is a balcony with a frosted railing. Across a dark gap stand other apartment towers, their windows lit in small rectangles of green and gold against an indigo night sky. Directly opposite, one apartment glows a warm gold, and through its curtains you can see a lit interior with its own small chandelier and plants. On the left, a long low dark sofa on a slim wooden frame runs off the edge of the picture, with a glass of amber whisky on its built-in side table. In front of it a wooden coffee table with a black central stripe holds a single textured vase, on a pale beige rug. Beside it sits a black leather armchair with wooden arms, and a fiddle-leaf fig in a white pot stands by the window. On the right, a pale concrete wall dotted with form-tie holes holds a large abstract painting: a big red disc, yellow dots, a curving black line and a few black vertical marks on pale blue-green. Below it a walnut sideboard holds liquor bottles and a dish of green olives or limes, and a tall palm stands in a white pot beside it. The mood is elegant, expensive, a little lonely: a quiet bachelor-pad night with the city glittering outside. The scene animates subtly across the windows and the night beyond. Lights shimmer in the city and in the glowing apartment opposite, and the plants and the reflections stir slightly, giving the view a gently living, flickering quality.
image.location.therapy-room.label: Therapy room
image.location.therapy-room.desc: A calm, softly lit counselling room, seen straight on at seated eye level, facing an empty armchair against a plain wall. In the lower centre sits a boxy armchair in caramel-brown leather, seen from the front, its plump back cushion and broad arms creased and glossy with soft highlights. Above it, on a warm taupe-grey wall, hangs a wide framed abstract print with a white mat in a thin black frame. Its flowing vertical bands of teal, sea-green, deep green and pale grey are cut by a ribbon of mustard yellow, and a thin white geometric wireframe dome sits over the lower left. On the right stands a tall slender floor lamp with a brushed-metal pole and a cord running down it. Its wide cream drum shade glows warmly and casts a golden halo on the wall and ceiling, so that side of the room is bathed in amber while the left stays cooler and greyer. On the left, a leafy potted palm with long, narrow, dark-green fronds rises from a square dark planter. Behind it is the edge of a window frame with a white sill and a faint cool glow of outside light. The room is uncluttered and deliberately soothing: neutral colours, soft lamplight, one empty chair waiting for someone. The atmosphere is quiet, private and slightly clinical despite its warmth.
image.location.therapy-room-rev.label: Therapy room, reverse view
image.location.therapy-room-rev.desc: The same counselling room as the main therapy room view, but seen from the opposite direction, as if from the other chair. Another matching caramel-brown leather armchair sits in the lower centre against the opposite wall, with the same muted taupe walls and the same soft, quiet light. The differences are clear. Instead of the teal abstract print, a large framed poster hangs above the chair: a misty Pacific Northwest landscape of layered blue mountain ridges under a peach-orange dusk sky, a calm grey sound or lake, and dark evergreen trees on a slope in the foreground. In its lower right corner is the slogan "Find yourself with eliza". The floor lamp and palm plant are gone. On the left is a closed door with a brass lever handle, and on the wall beside it a small wall thermostat whose green digital display reads "HEAT" and "70°". On the right, in place of the floor lamp, stands a slim bronze-framed open shelving unit. On its top shelf are upright books, a small bonsai tree in a shallow pot, and a table lamp with crossed brass legs and a pale shade. Below are stacked hardcover books with a tissue box on top, and a lower shelf of upright paperbacks and hardbacks beside a small carved wooden duck. The edge of a window with a white sill shows at the far right, mirroring the window at the far left of the other view. This side of the room feels a little more institutional and branded: the company slogan, the thermostat, the door and the box of tissues ready for the client. The lighting is softer and more even, without the strong amber glow of the floor lamp.
image.char.AnotherTherapist.name: Another therapist
image.char.AnotherTherapist.desc: A woman who looks to be in her late twenties or early thirties sits facing you directly, her body square to the viewer, leaning slightly forward with her forearms resting crossed over her knees and her hands loosely clasped, one laid over the other. Long, straight, chestnut-brown hair falls well past her shoulders, with a blunt fringe of bangs cut straight across her forehead. She wears thick black rectangular glasses, and clipped to the right temple of the frames is a small silver device, a compact wearable like a smart-glasses module. Her skin is a warm light-brown tone. Her expression is composed and neutral, lips closed, eyes steady and level on you: the patient, listening look of someone used to sitting across from people while they talk. She wears a soft, slouchy charcoal-grey cardigan or knit blazer with the sleeves pushed up a little, over a plain black crew-neck top, and dark trousers or leggings. Two long beaded necklaces hang down her chest, each ending in a teardrop-shaped green-and-turquoise stone pendant set in a gold rim, one hanging a little lower than the other. The overall impression is grounded, gentle, slightly bohemian, and professionally calm.
image.char.Darren.name: Darren
image.char.Darren.desc: A man in his late twenties or early thirties is shown from about the waist up, facing you but hunched forward, shoulders rounded and head tipped down so his gaze falls toward the floor just in front of him. His dark brown hair is a thick mop of tight, unruly curls, a little overgrown and messy on top. His skin is light, with a warm olive cast, and there is dark shadow under his eyes as if he has not slept. His brows are drawn together and pushed up in the middle, his lower lip pushed out and the corners of his mouth pulled down in an open, almost childlike frown: he looks deeply unhappy, sorry for himself, close to sulking or near tears. He wears a black zip-up soft-shell jacket hanging open, with a hood bunched at the back of his neck, grey contrast zipper tape, a vertical zip pocket on his left chest and a small grey stylised logo beside it. Under the jacket is a pale lavender-white button-up shirt, collar open, with a dark T-shirt peeking through at the throat. His arms hang straight down in front of him, hands balled loosely at his sides near his hips, as though he does not know what to do with them. The whole posture reads as dejected and defeated.
image.char.DarrenHappy.name: Darren
image.char.DarrenHappy.desc: Darren, a man in his late twenties or early thirties, stands in the same hunched pose as his default sprite: facing you, shoulders rounded, head tipped down so he looks toward the floor, arms hanging straight down with his hands loosely balled near his hips. His thick, curly dark brown hair is a messy mop on top, his skin light with a warm olive cast, and he still has tired shadows under his eyes. He wears the same open black zip-up soft-shell jacket with its bunched hood, grey zipper tape, chest zip pocket and small grey logo, over a pale lavender-white button-up shirt with a dark T-shirt at the throat. The only change is in his face. Compared with his default look, his brows have relaxed and smoothed out, no longer pinched and raised in the middle, and his lower lip is no longer pushed out in a pout; his mouth sits in a quieter, flatter line. He is not smiling, but the anguish has eased: he looks subdued, sheepish, and somewhat soothed, more quietly thoughtful than miserable.
image.char.Erlend.name: Erlend
image.char.Erlend.desc: A slim man who looks to be in his late twenties to mid-thirties stands at three-quarter length, body angled slightly to his left (your right) while his head turns back toward you and tilts a touch downward. His dark, nearly black hair is short at the sides with a thick, wavy tuft on top. His skin is a warm medium brown, his face long and narrow with a thin straight nose and a narrow chin. He wears thin dark rectangular glasses, and his eyes look slightly off to the side rather than straight at you. His mouth is closed in a small, tight, almost apologetic half-smile; the overall expression is mild, polite, a little uncomfortable or self-effacing. His body language is guarded: his right arm crosses in front of his stomach so that hand grips his own left forearm, while his left hand hangs low near his hip, holding a slim black pen or stylus. He wears a navy-blue crew-neck knit sweater over a pale blue collared shirt whose collar points sit neatly above the neckline, and brown trousers. A green lanyard hangs around his neck holding a clear badge holder at his chest, the look of an office worker on the job. The impression is a soft-spoken, tidy, slightly awkward professional.
image.char.Erlend__cafe-a.name: Erlend
image.char.Erlend__cafe-a.desc: Erlend appears here as a small, distant figure seen from the side, used when he is seated at the café. Only his head, shoulders and upper chest are visible, and he faces to the right in clean profile, looking ahead rather than at you. His short dark hair is thick and wavy on top, his skin a warm medium brown, and his thin dark rectangular glasses sit on a straight nose. His posture is upright and a little stiff, chin level, gaze fixed forward as if on someone sitting across from him. He wears the same outfit as his default look: a navy-blue crew-neck sweater with the cream or pale collar of a shirt showing at the neck. Compared with his main sprite, this one is tiny and much less detailed, his whole body turned sideways, with no lanyard, pen or crossed arm visible, so it reads as a background presence in the café scene rather than a close-up.
image.char.Evelyn.name: Evelyn
image.char.Evelyn.desc: A woman who looks to be in her thirties stands facing you squarely, shown from the head to about mid-thigh, with both hands pushed deep into the pockets of her coat. Her dark brown hair is cut in a chin-length, slightly tousled bob, with uneven bangs swept to one side across her forehead and a few loose strands curling out at the ends. Her skin is fair to light with warm undertones, her eyes a grey-green, and her face is calm, guarded and serious: brows level, lips closed in a neutral line, gaze steady and a little weary, as if she is quietly sizing things up. She wears a long, loose, dark navy work coat or chore jacket, buttoned down the front with large round wooden-brown buttons, a pointed collar, and flap pockets on the chest. Under it is a heather-grey zip-up hoodie with the hood bunched around her neck, white drawstrings hanging down and a brass-coloured zipper, and beneath that a dark green T-shirt just visible at the throat. Dark trousers show at the bottom. Her overall look is practical, understated, comfortable and a little withdrawn, the clothes of someone who prefers not to be noticed.
image.char.EvelynSuit.name: Evelyn
image.char.EvelynSuit.fade_in: Evelyn, in a dark blazer with a work badge
image.char.EvelynSuit.desc: Evelyn stands facing you, shown from the head to mid-thigh, in a more formal, workplace outfit than her usual coat and hoodie. She is a woman in her thirties with a chin-length, slightly tousled dark brown bob, side-swept bangs, fair skin with warm undertones, and grey-green eyes. Her expression is the same reserved, serious look as always, brows level, lips closed, eyes steady and a little tired. Here she wears a black, single-breasted tailored blazer with notched lapels, left open, over a soft heather-grey knit crew-neck sweater with a ribbed hem, and black trousers. A green lanyard hangs around her neck holding an ID badge at her chest; the badge shows a small photo of her and the word "SKANDHA" across the top, with a green stripe at the bottom. Her right hand hangs at her side, and her left hand is tucked partly into the front of her trouser pocket, thumb hooked at the hem of her blazer. Compared with her default look, she has traded the roomy navy chore coat and hoodie for this sharper, darker, more professional suit, and the company badge makes it clear she is dressed for work.
image.char.Evelyn__nightclub.name: Evelyn
image.char.Evelyn__nightclub.desc: Evelyn stands facing you, shown from the head to mid-thigh, both hands pushed into the pockets of her long coat. She is a woman in her thirties with a chin-length, slightly tousled dark brown bob, side-swept bangs and loose curling ends, fair skin, and grey-green eyes. Her face is calm, guarded and serious, lips closed, eyes steady and a little weary. She wears her usual outfit: a loose dark navy chore coat with large round wooden buttons, a pointed collar and chest flap pockets, over a heather-grey zip-up hoodie with the hood bunched around her neck, white drawstrings and a brass zipper, a dark green T-shirt at the throat, and dark trousers. This version of the sprite is identical in pose, clothing and expression to her default look; the only difference is the lighting. Her colours are tinted slightly warmer and redder, the cool blues pulled back, as if she is standing in the dim, reddish glow of the nightclub. She looks a little out of place here, dressed for the street rather than the dance floor.
image.char.Gabriel.name: Gabriel
image.char.Gabriel.desc: A man in his late twenties to mid-thirties faces you head-on, shown from the head to the waist, with his arms folded firmly across his chest. His dark hair is cut very short, close-cropped on the sides with a little more length on top, and his hairline is slightly receding at the temples. His skin is a light olive-tan, and he has a faint dark stubble along his jaw and upper lip. His brows are lowered and pulled together, eyes narrowed and fixed directly on you, lips pressed into a flat, hard line: a skeptical, defensive, unimpressed scowl, the look of someone who does not want to be here and is not going to be easily convinced. He wears a roomy heather-grey pullover hoodie with grey drawstrings hanging from the neckline, over a navy-blue T-shirt that shows at the collar. On the left side of the hoodie's chest is a navy-and-green Seattle Seahawks logo, the stylised profile of a hawk's head with a green eye. His shoulders are broad and his stance is solid and closed-off. The overall impression is a guarded, stubborn, ordinary local guy with his walls up.
image.char.Hariman.name: Hariman
image.char.Hariman.desc: A woman who looks to be in her late thirties to mid-forties is shown from the head to the waist, facing you, leaning very slightly forward, her left shoulder angled a little toward you as though she is seated and resting an arm on something just out of frame. Her black hair is cut short and choppy, longer and swept to one side on top with a tousled, slightly spiky texture, and short at the back and sides. Her skin is a warm medium brown, with dark brown eyes under thin, softly arched brows. Her head is tilted back a fraction so she looks at you slightly down her nose, her eyelids a little heavy, and her lips are closed in a faint, knowing half-smile: confident, relaxed, appraising, perhaps a touch amused. She wears a slate-blue tailored blazer with notched lapels and a breast pocket flap, over a deep maroon, wine-red button-up shirt worn open at the collar. The look is polished but unfussy, the outfit of an executive or professional who is comfortable with authority. The overall impression is of someone self-possessed and in control of the conversation.
image.char.Holiday.name: Holiday
image.char.Holiday.desc: An older woman, perhaps in her late fifties or sixties, faces you directly, shown from the head to the waist, her arms relaxed and hanging down in front of her. Her hair is a full, chin-length mass of tight dark curls shot through with grey, a little wild and windblown. Her skin is a warm, light-medium tan, lined with age: crow's feet at the corners of her eyes, smile lines around her mouth, creases across her brow. Her eyes are a clear blue-grey. She wears a small, closed-mouth smile and her brows are lifted slightly in the middle, giving her a kindly, wistful, gently sympathetic expression, warm but with a hint of sadness or weariness behind it. She wears a burgundy fleece zip-up vest with a high collar, left open, with a small rectangular brand patch on the left chest, over a long-sleeved T-shirt striped horizontally in pale pinkish-cream and dark grey, with a scooped grey neckline. The clothes are practical and outdoorsy, the comfortable layers of someone who spends time outside in the Pacific Northwest damp. The overall impression is approachable, motherly and down-to-earth.
image.char.Mark.name: Mark
image.char.Mark.desc: Mark is a heavyset white man somewhere in his forties, shown from the waist up and facing the viewer squarely, his thick forearms folded firmly across his belly in a closed, guarded stance. His wavy, light-brown hair is parted in the middle and swept back from a high forehead, falling in loose, slightly unkempt curls over his ears. He wears dark, rectangular, thin-framed glasses, and behind them his grey-green eyes are heavy-lidded and half-lowered, giving him a tired, skeptical, faintly weary look. A dark brown moustache joins a short goatee on his chin, and a shadow of stubble covers his round cheeks and jaw. His mouth is a flat, pressed line, neither smiling nor frowning, the expression of someone waiting to be convinced. His skin is fair with a ruddy flush. He wears a deep brick-red short-sleeved polo shirt with the collar open, the fabric pulling a little across his broad shoulders and soft middle. The overall impression is of a stolid, no-nonsense man holding his ground, patient but unmoved.
image.char.Maya.name: Maya
image.char.Maya.desc: Maya is a slim young woman who looks to be in her twenties, shown from the chest up and facing the viewer directly with her shoulders square. Her long, straight, reddish-brown hair is parted in the middle and falls past her shoulders, a few loose strands drifting at the sides. She wears amber-brown, rectangular glasses, and behind them her brown eyes look straight ahead with a calm, level, slightly guarded gaze. Her lips are closed in a neutral line and her expression is serious and self-contained, hard to read, with perhaps a hint of wariness. Her skin is fair with a warm tone. She dresses in a layered, thrift-store-artsy style: a mustard-yellow wool coat with wide lapels hangs open over a muted olive-grey knit sweater flecked with small pale and rust-coloured dashes, and from its neckline peeks a pointed navy collar printed with little white and orange flowers. A small round enamel pin, teal with a cartoonish face, is fastened to the left lapel of her coat. The overall impression is of a thoughtful, reserved, quietly observant person.
image.char.Nora.name: Nora
image.char.Nora.desc: Nora is a lean young woman who appears to be in her mid-to-late twenties, shown at three-quarter length standing upright and facing the viewer, her body turned just slightly to her right. Her platinum-blonde hair is cut in a short, tousled undercut, longer on top and swept up and over to one side, with a wispy strand curling down by her ear. She has striking pale blue eyes, strong straight eyebrows, high cheekbones and a defined jaw; her head tilts a touch, and she wears a faint, knowing half-smile, her gaze cool, direct and a little teasing. Her skin is fair with warm, sunlit tones. She wears an unzipped dark olive-green windbreaker with a hood, its zipper edged with a bright yellow-orange stripe and a toggled drawcord dangling from the hood; the sleeves are bunched at the wrists. Underneath is a loose, scoop-necked white T-shirt printed across the chest with the word "Оливокс" in black Cyrillic letters, followed by a small circular logo, tucked loosely into dark jeans. Her arms hang relaxed at her sides. The overall impression is of someone easy, self-assured and a little rebellious, comfortable in her own skin.
image.char.NoraExplaining.name: Nora
image.char.NoraExplaining.fade_in: Nora, reaching out as she explains
image.char.NoraExplaining.desc: This is a small, distant view of two people standing side by side, drawn from the waist up with their lower legs and shoes visible as separate fragments beneath, as though they are standing behind a counter or table that hides the middle of their bodies. On the left is Nora, recognisable by her short, tousled platinum-blonde hair swept to one side and her open dark olive-green jacket over a grey-white scoop-necked top. Her head is bowed slightly and turned toward the right, her expression focused and earnest, and her right arm reaches out across the space between them, her hand coming to rest low near the other person's side, as if pointing something out or guiding them while she talks. Beside her on the right stands a slighter figure with shoulder-length, shaggy dark brown hair, wearing a black jacket with a column of buttons over a grey hood, head tipped down, gaze lowered toward where Nora is gesturing, quiet and attentive. Below, a pair of dark trainers with white stripes and a pair of plain dark shoes show where they stand. Compared to Nora's default portrait, this is a much smaller, more distant shot showing her mid-gesture and engaged with someone else, rather than facing the viewer.
image.char.Nora__cafe-a.name: Nora
image.char.Nora__cafe-a.fade_in: Nora, seen in profile at the café
image.char.Nora__cafe-a.desc: A small, close-cropped view of Nora shown from the shoulders up and in full profile, facing to the right as if looking across a table at someone beside her. Her short platinum-blonde hair is tousled and swept forward, a loose fringe falling toward her brow and the shaved sides showing behind her ear. From the side her face is sharp and clean-lined: a straight nose, high cheekbone, pale blue eye looking ahead, and lips closed in a relaxed, neutral, attentive expression, perhaps listening. Her skin is fair with a warm, peachy glow from the café light. She wears her dark olive-green hooded jacket, the hood bunched softly behind her neck, with a glimpse of the yellow-orange zipper trim at the front. Unlike her default upright, front-facing portrait, this version is a small side view of her head and shoulders, more intimate and conversational, as if she is seated in the middle of a chat.
image.char.Nora__nightclub.name: Nora
image.char.Nora__nightclub.fade_in: Nora, in the club's warm light
image.char.Nora__nightclub.desc: Nora is a lean young woman who appears to be in her mid-to-late twenties, shown at three-quarter length standing upright and facing the viewer, her body angled just slightly. Her platinum-blonde hair is cut in a short, tousled undercut, swept up and over to one side, with a wispy strand curling by her ear. She has pale blue eyes, strong brows and high cheekbones, and wears a faint, knowing half-smile, her head tilted and her gaze cool, direct and a little teasing. She wears her unzipped dark olive-green hooded windbreaker with bright yellow-orange zipper trim and a dangling drawcord, over a loose white scoop-necked T-shirt printed with the Cyrillic word "Оливокс" and a small round logo, and dark jeans. Her arms hang relaxed at her sides. This is the same pose and outfit as her default look, but the whole figure is washed in warmer, redder, dimmer light, her skin and the white shirt taking on an amber glow from the nightclub's lighting, which gives her a moodier, after-dark feel.
image.char.Rae.name: Rae
image.char.Rae.desc: Rae is a woman who looks to be in her late thirties or forties, shown from the thighs up, standing with her body turned slightly to her right while her face is toward the viewer. Her dark brown hair is pulled up into a loose bun on top of her head, with a few soft strands escaping around her face and neck. She has warm brown skin, dark, heavy-lidded brown eyes with faint shadows beneath them, and a gentle, closed-lipped smile that reads as kind, patient and a little tired, the look of someone used to listening. Small gold hoop earrings hang from her ears and a thin gold chain with a tiny pendant rests at her collarbone. She wears a tailored wine-red blazer, unbuttoned, over a fitted peach-pink top printed with large pink lily-like blossoms on dark branching stems and leaves, and a dark skirt or trousers. Her arms hang loosely at her sides. The overall impression is of a composed, caring professional, approachable and grounded.
image.char.Rae__raes-house.name: Rae
image.char.Rae__raes-house.fade_in: Rae, relaxed at home in an apron
image.char.Rae__raes-house.desc: Rae is a woman who looks to be in her late thirties or forties, shown from the thighs up, her body turned slightly to her right and her face toward the viewer. Her dark brown hair is gathered into the same loose bun on top of her head, with a few wisps falling around her face and neck. She has warm brown skin, dark, heavy-lidded brown eyes with faint shadows beneath them, and a soft, closed-lipped smile, kind and a little weary. At home she is dressed simply and comfortably: a soft, cream-coloured, ribbed long-sleeved sweater with a round neck, and over it a plain beige canvas apron edged with slate-blue trim along the bib, neck strap and a single wide front pocket. Her arms hang relaxed at her sides. Compared with her default look, the professional wine-red blazer, floral top and gold jewellery are gone, replaced by this homely, muted outfit that suggests cooking or tending her home, making her seem more relaxed and domestic.
image.char.Rainer.name: Rainer
image.char.Rainer.desc: Rainer is a man who looks to be in his thirties or early forties, shown at three-quarter length, standing with his body angled slightly to his left while his face turns toward the viewer. His thick black hair is neatly cut, short at the sides and swept back on top. He has an East Asian appearance, with tanned, warm-toned skin, strong dark brows drawn slightly together, and dark eyes that look out with a serious, focused, almost brooding intensity. His mouth is set in a firm, unsmiling line. He wears a sleek, well-cut black suit jacket with a slim grey pocket square showing in the breast pocket, over a crisp pale grey dress shirt left open at the collar with no tie. His right hand is raised to his waist, closed in a loose fist at the jacket's single button as if about to fasten or adjust it, while his left arm hangs straight down at his side, a black cufflink visible at the shirt cuff. The overall impression is of a polished, driven, controlled man, confident and slightly guarded.
image.char.Soren.name: Soren
image.char.Soren.fade_in: Soren, gentle and a little rumpled
image.char.Soren.desc: Soren is an older man, perhaps in his late fifties or sixties, shown at three-quarter length, standing with his body turned slightly to his right and his face toward the viewer. His thick silver-grey hair is swept back from his forehead in a full, slightly untamed wave, and a short grey beard and moustache cover his jaw and upper lip. His skin is light olive and weathered, with lines across his forehead and crow's feet around his eyes. His brows are raised a little in the middle and his dark eyes look out with a soft, rueful, somewhat sad or apologetic expression, his mouth closed in a faint, wry line, the face of a thoughtful man carrying something heavy. He wears a loose, slightly rumpled brown wool sport coat over a patterned sweater vest knitted in horizontal bands of cream, tan, rose, grey and muted green, with small diamond and zigzag motifs, and beneath it a pale blue collared shirt. His left hand is tucked into his trouser pocket and his right arm hangs relaxed. The overall impression is of a warm, professorial, world-weary man.
image.char.Soren__nightclub.name: Soren
image.char.Soren__nightclub.fade_in: Soren, in the club's warm light
image.char.Soren__nightclub.desc: Soren is an older man, perhaps in his late fifties or sixties, shown at three-quarter length, his body turned slightly to his right and his face toward the viewer. His thick silver-grey hair is swept back in a full wave, and a short grey beard and moustache frame his weathered face, with lines across his brow and around his eyes. His brows lift a little in the middle and his dark eyes carry a soft, rueful, faintly sad expression, his mouth a wry, closed line. He wears his loose brown wool sport coat over a banded, Fair Isle-style sweater vest in cream, tan, rose and muted green with small diamond motifs, a pale collared shirt beneath, and his left hand is tucked into his trouser pocket. The pose and clothing are the same as his default look, but here the whole figure is bathed in a warmer, redder, dimmer light from the nightclub, deepening the browns of his jacket and giving his skin and hair an amber cast, so he seems moodier and a little out of place in the after-dark setting.
image.avatar.Andrea.name: Andrea
image.avatar.Andrea.desc: Not a face but a pixel-art icon of an ornate gold tiara or crown, centered on a flat, very dark charcoal-brown square. The crown's base is a low gold band studded with small square-cut green gems. Above it rise diamond-shaped gold settings, each holding a green emerald: a large one at the top center on a tall middle spike, two large ones at the outer ends, and smaller ones filling the gaps, all joined by thin gold filigree. White four-pointed sparkle glints radiate from the top gem and several others, so the whole piece seems to glitter. The style is crisp, small-scale pixel art in pale gold, deep green and white. It gives an impression of luxury, glamour and maybe a touch of self-styled royalty. The larger header image is the same crown drawn at higher resolution, with sharper sparkles and clearer facets on each emerald.
image.avatar.Erlend.name: Erlend
image.avatar.Erlend.desc: Not a face but a pixel-art landscape icon filling the whole square: a dense stand of evergreen conifer trees seen from ground level against a bright mint-to-jade green sky. The trees are drawn as overlapping layered silhouettes in several shades of green, from pale misty sea-green in the back rows to deep forest green in front, which gives a sense of depth and fog, like a Pacific Northwest or Nordic forest. The tallest, darkest fir stands just right of center, its pointed tip reaching near the top edge, with smaller pointed tops crowding around it. There are no people, text or other colours; the whole image is monochrome green. It feels calm, quiet, outdoorsy and a little remote. The larger header image is the same forest at higher resolution, showing the stepped, layered branches of each tree more clearly and a soft hazy treeline at the upper left.
image.avatar.Evelyn.name: Evelyn
image.avatar.Evelyn.desc: A plain monogram icon rather than a face: a large lowercase letter "e" in a rounded, simple sans-serif typeface, centered on a flat square of bright coral-pink, close to watermelon red. The letter is a paler, washed-out pink, only slightly lighter than the background, so it reads as a soft, low-contrast tone-on-tone mark. There are no other details, borders or text. It looks like a default placeholder avatar of the kind a messaging app makes from a person's initial, which suits it being the player's own profile picture. There is no larger header image: the header file for Evelyn is blank.
image.avatar.Garrett.name: Garrett
image.avatar.Garrett.desc: Not a face but a pixel-art icon of a cocktail: a classic martini glass, V-shaped bowl on a long thin stem and flat round foot, centered on a flat square of warm coral-pink to salmon red. The glass is outlined in pale mint and filled with a bright minty-green drink. A single round green olive sits in the drink, speared on a thin pale pink cocktail pick that angles up and out past the top right of the rim. There are no people or text. The image suggests nightlife, cocktail bars, partying or a playful, sociable personality. The larger header image is the same martini at higher resolution, with a cleaner glass outline, a visible pale rim line across the top of the drink, and a more clearly round olive.
image.avatar.Holiday.name: Holiday
image.avatar.Holiday.desc: A plain monogram icon rather than a face: a large lowercase letter "h" in bold white, in a rounded, simple sans-serif typeface, centered slightly left on a flat square of soft pastel pink, like salmon or blush. The white letter stands out crisply against the pink. There are no other details, borders, people or text. It looks like a messaging app's default avatar made from a person's initial, a generic placeholder rather than a chosen picture. There is no larger header image: the header file for Holiday is blank.
image.avatar.Jenn.name: Jenn
image.avatar.Jenn.desc: Not a face but a flat graphic icon of a stylised, all-seeing eye on a solid dark teal or slate-green square. The eye is a pointed almond shape drawn in a thin coral-red outline, with a small horizontal tick extending from its left corner. Inside is a large round iris in bright teal with a solid coral-red pupil at the center. Three short bright cyan lines radiate upward from above the eye, one straight up and one angled out to each side, like rays or eyelashes, suggesting the eye is glowing or watching. There is no text. The look is graphic, slightly mystical or occult, as if it were a symbol of vigilance, insight or surveillance. The larger header image is the same eye at higher resolution, with smoother lines and a thin lighter teal ring between the iris and the red pupil.
image.avatar.Maya.name: Maya
image.avatar.Maya.desc: A cartoon emoji-style icon rather than a photo of a person: a round, teal-blue monster face set on a muted dusky purple square. The face is outlined in thick black lines, like a sticker. Two short, pale sky-blue horns curve up from the top left and right, and a ragged tuft of dark green hair sits between them. The eyes are big red rings with dark teal centres, giving a wide, startled or glaring stare. The mouth is a flat, slightly downturned black line with two tiny yellow fangs poking up at the corners, so the creature looks grumpy, sulky or mock-menacing rather than truly scary. It reads like a playful little-monster avatar a young person might choose. There is no larger header image for Maya; that slot is blank.
image.avatar.Nikki.name: Nikki
image.avatar.Nikki.desc: Not a photo of a person but a simple icon: two glossy cartoon hearts on a deep wine-red or burgundy square. The hearts are a bright cherry red, each with a small white highlight on its upper left curve and a lighter pink sheen along its lower right edge, like shiny candy or plastic stickers. One heart sits in the upper left and a second, the same size, sits lower right, so they form a diagonal pair running from top left to bottom right. The look is cute and affectionate, the kind of avatar someone picks to say "love" or "romance". The larger header image is the same design, more closely cropped, so the hearts appear bigger and fill more of the square.
image.avatar.Nora.name: Nora
image.avatar.Nora.desc: A bold, flat-colour graphic of a black cat's head and neck in profile, facing right, on a saturated magenta-purple square. The cat is almost pure silhouette black, with one tall pointed ear at the back showing a hot-pink inner ear and a second ear peaking above it. Its single visible eye is a round hot-pink circle with a black vertical slit pupil looking forward, giving an alert, curious, slightly wide-eyed expression. A tiny pink nose dots the tip of the muzzle. Around its neck is a hot-pink collar with a small round tag or bell at the front. The style is minimal and poster-like, with just black, pink and purple, and it feels stylish and a little cheeky. The larger header image is the same cat cropped closer, so the head fills most of the square and the collar tag sits at the bottom edge.
image.avatar.Paul.name: Paul
image.avatar.Paul.desc: A muted, almost greyscale illustration of a dog sitting upright and facing the viewer, shown full body from head to haunches, on a flat warm grey background. The dog is a light grey breed with upright pointed ears outlined in pale grey, a pale face, and a darker grey nose. Its head is tilted up slightly with eyes narrowed or squinting, as if content or basking, and the mouth seems slightly open in a relaxed, happy look. It wears a thin dark collar. The chest is lighter grey, and a dark charcoal patch runs down the front between its legs, suggesting dark front legs or shadow. The style is flat, with soft shapes and very little colour, giving a calm, quiet, slightly melancholy feel. The larger header image is the same dog, cropped a little closer and shown bigger.
image.avatar.Rae.name: Rae
image.avatar.Rae.desc: Not a person but a stylised potted houseplant on a very dark blue-green, almost charcoal-teal square. The plant has long, sharp, spear-shaped leaves fanning out and drooping outward on both sides, drawn in angular flat planes of turquoise, sea green, and one brighter mint-green leaf in the centre, with some thin curving stems visible. It sits in a short, wide, rounded pot in deep teal with a soft vertical highlight on its right side. Everything is in cool greens and blues, giving a calm, low-key, slightly moody feeling. The larger header image is the same plant, cropped closer and larger, so the leaves spill toward the edges and the pot sits at the bottom.
image.avatar.Rainer.name: Rainer
image.avatar.Rainer.desc: A sleek corporate-style icon rather than a face: a three-dimensional stack of bricks drawn in isometric perspective, centred on a near-black background with a faint dark grey radial glow. The bricks are hollow black blocks outlined in glowing pale mint-green and white edges, arranged like a short section of wall, three rows high, with offset joints like real brickwork. The top surfaces catch the most light and shine pale aqua, and the glow fades toward the bottom rows. It looks like a polished tech company logo, cold, solid and impersonal, suggesting building, structure and foundations. The larger header image is the same brick stack, shown bigger and more closely cropped.
image.avatar.Sarah.name: Sarah
image.avatar.Sarah.desc: A cheerful cartoon icon of a single ripe tomato on a bright mint-green square. The tomato is round and orange-red, with a dark green star-shaped leafy calyx and a short stem on top. It has a small white shine on its upper left and a softer pinkish highlight on its lower right, and it casts a dark green drop shadow down to the right, giving it a little depth. The style is flat, clean and friendly, like an app icon or sticker, and the bright red against green feels fresh, wholesome and homey, perhaps hinting at cooking or gardening. The larger header image is the same tomato, cropped closer and larger, filling most of the square.
image.avatar.Soren.name: Soren
image.avatar.Soren.desc: A painted, realistic head-and-shoulders portrait of a man, rendered entirely in warm sepia browns against a solid black background, like an old tinted photograph or an oil study. He appears to be in his forties or fifties, with thick, swept-back wavy hair that falls in loose strands over the left side of his forehead. His face is long with strong cheekbones, deep-set eyes under heavy brows, lines on his forehead, and creases running from his nose to the corners of his mouth. His brows are slightly raised and drawn together and his mouth is a thin, tight line, giving a weary, worried, or quietly pained expression. Only the open collar of a shirt and jacket shows at the bottom. The larger header image is the same painting, cropped closer so his face fills the frame.
image.avatar.Willa.name: Willa
image.avatar.Willa.desc: A whimsical icon of a shooting star on a deep dark teal-green square scattered with tiny cream-coloured dots like distant stars. A small, soft cream five-pointed star sits in the lower right, and behind it three broad curved trails sweep up and away toward the top left like a rainbow tail: a teal band on top, a coral-pink band in the middle, and a lime-green band below, each fading out as it reaches the edge. The style is flat and gentle, with soft colours, and it feels hopeful, dreamy and a little childlike, the kind of avatar someone picks for wishes or imagination. The larger header image is the same shooting star, shown bigger and closer, with the tail trails filling much of the upper left.
